HOOK: Start by stating what everyone believes, then signal you disagree. Use 'Everyone says X. They're wrong.'
BODY: Use 9-point numbered or bulleted list. Each point should be 1-2 lines max.
CTA: End with a follow CTA that promises ongoing value.
